leadText:
Poké TV (Japanese: ポケTV POKéTV) is a segment that occurs after the ending of episodes belonging to the XY&Z saga of , featuring programs about . It was featured from XY094 to XY139, and was preceded by Professor Oak's Pokémon Holo Caster and was succeeded by Poké Problem.

The segment starts off by switching through channels until one is chosen for the episode. Each segment features a Pokémon from the selected program. Some episodes also feature extra scenes from the episode and clips from previous series.
